Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Manager AI Initiatives.

Business: Finance COO

Principal Responsibilities

As an AI Agent Architect/Developer, you’ll own the end-to-end architecture and technical delivery of an enterprise AI Agent / AI-native engineering platform. You’ll drive the deep integration of large language models (LLMs), AI agents, and knowledge capabilities into the software development lifecycle—covering requirements analysis, solution generation, code collaboration, automated testing, and environment orchestration—so teams can deliver intelligently, securely, and at scale. You’ll turn model capability into reusable, extensible, and governable platform services, and continuously evolve the AI-native architecture through real-world implementation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Platform architecture & core capability design

Lead overall architecture design and core capability development for an AI Agent platform, including task orchestration, tool invocation, context management, memory mechanisms, and multi-agent collaboration.

  • AI-native engineering integration

Embed AI-native capabilities into engineering workflows, such as AI coding, technical solution generation, test case generation, test report generation, and automated environment setup/orchestration.

  • Knowledge augmentation layer design

Design, Integrate, And Apply Enterprise Knowledge Enhancement Capabilities, Including

RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)

GraphRAG

Knowledge graphs (design, integration, and application)

  • Runtime governance & operational framework

Establish AI Agent Runtime And Governance Frameworks, Including

Isolation and sandboxing

Access control and permissioning

Auditability and traceability

Evaluation and quality measurement

Stability, reliability, and cost management

  • Cross-functional delivery

Partner with Product, Engineering, QA, Operations, and platform teams to standardise and productionise platform capabilities, improving delivery quality and engineering efficiency.

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or above (preferred majors: Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, or related fields).
  • Experience:

8+ years in backend/platform engineering, architecture, or similar enterprise-scale delivery roles.

Recent 3 years, working in a commercial environment to deliver AI related production

  • System thinking: Strong ability to design and evolve complex systems with a focus on scalability, maintainability, and performance.
  • Engineering strength: Proficient in Java/Python with strong coding fundamentals and architectural judgment; hands-on experience delivering complex systems.
  • AI/Agent Architecture Skills (Must Have)

Deep Understanding Of LLMs And Agent Architectures, Including

Task decomposition & planning

Tool use / function calling patterns

Context and session management

Memory design

Execution loops and exception handling

Practical experience with LangChain and/or LangGraph (or equivalent orchestration frameworks).

Familiarity with mainstream AI coding and developer tools (examples: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot or equvlenece).

  • Knowledge & Retrieval Engineering (Strong Plus)

Hands-on experience designing and implementing enterprise RAG, GraphRAG, or knowledge graph solutions for real application scenarios.

  • Platform & Cloud Engineering (Strong Plus)

Strong DevOps mindset; experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD, Kubernetes, and cloud-native technologies.

Ability to drive cross-team execution and deliver outcomes in production environments.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

Developing our Premier Elite customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier Elite clientele portfolio

Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs

Promoting our Premier Elite Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate

Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service, and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance

Premier Relationship Director require exceptional ability to build trusting relationships with existing and potential Premier Elite clients, help clients articulate their needs, and deliver to exceed client expectations.

扩大卓越尊尚客户群，并与卓越尊尚客户建立长期关系

根据卓越尊尚客户的财务需求提供合适的金融及投资产品服务，管理客户的财富

向潜在客户推广卓越理财服务，发掘他们的需求并且在适当的情况下推荐客户至其他业务部门

配合执行分行改进措施，反映客户的意见，并确保符合分行的运作要求和品质保证

卓越尊尚客户总监需要具备与现有客户和潜在客户建立互信的关系，帮助客户表达真实需求，以及帮助客户达成期望的能力

Qualifications

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

University level education, preferably in finance, business, or a related discipline

At least 5 years as Relationship Manager.

Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability

Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills

High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers

Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets

Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure

Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills

Fluency in Mandarin and English

本科及以上学历，金融、商科或相关学科更佳

至少5年以上客户经理经验

具有前线客户服务经验，善于建立客户关系

具有优秀销售及客户服务技巧，善于沟通及人际交流

以客户为本，致力为客户提供优质服务

了解并对金融市场有浓厚兴趣

成熟独立，能在压力下有良好表现

具有出色商业思维及敏锐人际技巧

普通话及英语流利

我们的福利

汇丰为员工提供全面、贴心的关怀与福利，自入职第一天起，员工就可以在多样化和人性化的工作场所做出积极选择，满足自己多层次的需求。

  • 假期福利

除法定休假外，有年假、带薪病假、志愿者假、妇女节、休假等。您入职后即可享有10~25天的丰厚年假，让您在工作之余有充分的时间放松身心。在您生日当月，更有一天生日假，您可以和家人、朋友等一起庆祝这温馨的时刻。

  • 全面的福利保险计划

包括定期寿险、意外伤亡险、重疾险、补充商业医疗保险等，覆盖全方位生活场景，为您的保障添砖加瓦。

  • 员工体检

每年为您提供一次关爱体检，有多种套餐，全面评估您的身体状况和生活方式，帮助您实现健康生活、快乐工作。

  • 弹性福利

当您考虑为家庭提供更多保障时，My Choice员工弹性福利平台可以满足您不同人生阶段的各种需求。每年您都享有弹性福利积分，可以调整您的福利保险，买卖年假，为家人购买体检套餐等，DIY一份专属于您的福利计划。

  • 心理健康咨询

您和您的直系亲属均可免费获得专业的心理健康咨询，包含个人成长、缓解职场压力、解决情感困惑等，助您一路“升级打怪”，稳步前进。

  • 企业年金

汇丰企业年金这一补充养老金计划为您更添一份保障。建立企业账户和个人账户，由汇丰和您按照一定比例每月缴存。更有专业的金融机构共同运营，确保年金资金的安全独立、灵活投资，您可在退休时领取，提升您退休后的生活品质。

  • 弹性工作

为了让大家发挥最佳表现，您有各种弹性工作的灵活选择。

  • PSQP专业进修计划

专业进修计划通过为员工报销学费的方式鼓励员工追求职业发展。员工可就经PSQP批核的进修计划和经批核学位列表中涵盖的专业进修享受学费报销

ln:4451176590.descriptionHtml:
Natixis Corporate & Investment Banking is a leading global financial institution that provides advisory, investment banking, financing, corporate banking and capital markets services to corporations, financial institutions, financial sponsors and sovereign and supranational organizations worldwide.


Our teams of experts in close to 30 countries advise clients on their strategic development, helping them to grow and transform their businesses, and maximize their positive impact. Natixis CIB is committed to aligning its financing portfolio with a carbon neutrality path by 2050 while helping its clients reduce the environmental impact of their business.


As part of Groupe BPCE, the second largest banking group in France through the Banque Populaire and Caisse d’Epargne retail networks, Natixis CIB benefits from the Group’s financial strength and solid financial ratings (Standard & Poor's: A+, Moody's: A2, Fitch: A+, R&I: A+).


Job Description Summary:


Support development of a portfolio of global Corporate companies together with Relation Manager and Senior Banker:

  • Support Relation Manager and Senior banker in brainstorming, bizcom memo and pitch
  • Work closely with Product lines in working out suitable solutions to meet clients' needs
  • Perform credit due diligence and ensure portfolio returns and credit quality are aligned to risk appetite in relation with Portfolio Management and Risk.
  • Ensure compliance with all relevant regulations and policies, take care of KYC process
  • Follow operations requirement


Main Responsibilities:


Business & Credit analysis

  • BizCom documentation (financial analysis, business memo…)
  • Perform fundamental analysis in order to support the exposure request
  • Communicate with credit risk department to better anticipate risk issues


Support Relationship manager & Senior banker

  • Prepare marketing material, commercial action plan, client budget, client briefing memo, pitch book
  • Manage follow up action plan with client and product teams


Lead administrative tasks related to client onboarding

  • KYC management
  • Day to day client needs with BO team


Required Skills:


  • Mandarin and English
  • Well structured, organized and systematic
  • Solid analytical skills
  • Elevated grammatical and excellent written communication skills: ability to draft memos
  • Ability to cope with time pressure and work to deadlines
  • Good communication
  • Good understanding of banking activities
  • Ability to be a good team player
  • Good knowledge and ability on Microsoft Office
  • Min. Bachelor degree education
  • CFA and CPA (preferred)
  • Credit analysis knowledge (corporate skills): ROE, RWA, financial statement

Job Description

Senior Manager, Renewable Energy Asset Management

Function: Renewable Infrastructure Investment and Asset Management

Location: Beijing, China

Employment type: Permanent

Reporting to: Head of China Renewable Infrastructure

About Us

Schroders is a global investment manager which provides active asset management, wealth management and investment solutions. We aim to provide excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We serve a diverse client base that includes pension schemes, insurance companies, sovereign wealth funds, endowments, foundations, high net worth individuals, family offices, as well as end clients through partnerships with distributors, financial advisers, and online platforms.

Established in 1804, we have around 5,500 people across 36 global locations. Schroders' success can be attributed to its diversified business model, spanning different asset classes, client types and geographies.

Role purpose

The Senior Manager, Technical & Asset Management is responsible for the day-to-day technical and asset management of the firm’s renewable-energy portfolio in China.

The role covers the full asset lifecycle, including pre-investment technical due diligence, construction oversight, operational performance, equipment and warranty matters, contractor management, technical reporting and exit preparation.

The successful candidate will lead the existing technical team and act as the primary interface between project-level technical activities and the Director. The role is expected to convert technical findings into clear assessments of financial, contractual and operational impact, develop practical recommendations and ensure that agreed actions are implemented.

The position requires a combination of renewable-energy technical experience, owner-side asset management capability, commercial awareness, team leadership and strong English communication skills.

Key responsibilities 1. Technical due diligence and investment support

  • Lead technical due diligence for potential wind, solar and other renewable-energy investments.
  • Review third-party resource assessments and energy-yield studies, and form independent in-house view.
  • Appoint and manage external technical advisers and ensure that their work addresses the key investment risks.
  • Reviewing and validating technical assumptions from sellers, developers, OEMs and advisers, and forming a documented internal technical view
  • Identify material technical risks, quantify their potential impact and propose appropriate mitigation measures.
  • Provide verified technical inputs and mitigation measures for investment models, transaction documentation and Investment Committee materials.
  • Support the Director in determining how technical risks should be reflected in valuation, transaction structure and contractual protections.

2. Construction management

  • Oversee the construction of renewable-energy projects from an owner’s perspective.
  • Monitor construction progress, quality, HSE, permitting, commissioning and grid connection.
  • Assess progress against contractual and investment-case milestones.
  • Review contractor recovery plans and monitor implementation.
  • Ensure that technical completion, testing, acceptance and handover requirements are properly documented.
  • Escalate matters that may affect COD, grid connection, revenue commencement, subsidy or CFD eligibility, transaction milestones or contractual rights.

3. Operational asset management

  • Oversee the technical and operational performance of operating renewable-energy assets.
  • Monitor generation, availability, utilisation hours, curtailment, equipment reliability, tariff-related operational matters, OPEX and material budget variances.
  • Compare actual performance with the original investment case, annual budget and latest forecast.
  • Identify the root causes of material underperformance and develop corrective-action plans.
  • Review annual operating plans, maintenance strategies and material CAPEX proposals.
  • Monitor O&M contractor performance and compliance with contractual obligations.
  • Support performance improvement, cost optimisation and asset-value enhancement initiatives.

4. Equipment quality, warranties and claims

  • Lead the technical workstream for material equipment defects, performance issues and construction-quality disputes.
  • Coordinate root-cause analysis, inspections, testing and independent technical reviews.
  • Preserve technical evidence and ensure compliance with contractual notification requirements.
  • Assess warranty coverage, supplier responsibility, remediation options and potential operational impact.
  • Work with Legal, Investment and other internal functions to develop claims and negotiation strategies.
  • Monitor potential generation losses, additional costs and other financial consequences.
  • Escalate material claims and proposed commercial settlements to the Director for decision.

5. Contract and counterparty management

  • Monitor technical compliance under EPC, O&M, equipment-supply, warranty and other material project contracts.
  • Track key deliverables, performance guarantees, liquidated damages, warranties and acceptance requirements.
  • Support technical and commercial negotiations with OEMs, EPC contractors, O&M providers and project partners.
  • Ensure that the firm’s contractual rights are supported by appropriate technical evidence.
  • Implement agreed contractual and commercial actions following Director-level approval.

6. Portfolio reporting and UK communication

  • Prepare clear, decision-focused monthly technical and asset management reports.
  • Explain the potential financial, contractual, valuation and investment implications of technical matters.
  • Lead routine English-language technical and asset management discussions with UK team .
  • Support the Director in preparing Investment Committee, fund-governance, LP and senior-management communications.

7. Team leadership and operating model

  • Lead and develop the existing technical and asset management team.
  • Set clear responsibilities, priorities, deliverables and quality standards.
  • Allocate work across operations, construction/HSE, resource assessment and performance analysis.
  • Establish an effective reporting and escalation protocol for the team.
  • Develop standard procedures, dashboards, risk registers and reporting templates.

Candidate requirements Essential experience

  • At least seven years of relevant experience in renewable energy, infrastructure or power-sector technical and asset management.
  • Sound understanding of energy-yield assessment, with the ability to review and sense-check generation calculations independently.
  • Meaningful experience with wind projects; solar or other renewable-energy experience is advantageous.
  • Owner-side experience covering both construction and operating assets.
  • Experience managing technical due diligence and external technical advisers.
  • Practical knowledge of project construction, commissioning, grid connection and operational performance.
  • Experience managing EPC contractors, OEMs, O&M providers and other technical counterparties.
  • Previous responsibility for managing staff, advisers or multidisciplinary project teams.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in engineering, energy, power systems or a related discipline.

Language

  • Native or fully professional Mandarin Chinese.
  • Strong written and spoken English is essential.

We recognise potential, whoever you are

Our purpose is to deliver excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We believe diverse perspectives and an inclusive culture help us make better decisions and achieve better outcomes for our clients. That's why inclusion is a strategic priority for us, and we are an equal opportunities employer. You are welcome here, regardless of your age, disability, gender identity, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, socio-economic background, or any other protected characteristic.

We will consider flexible working arrangements for all roles and provide reasonable accommodations to support applicants and employees, including those with neurodiversity, disability, or physical and mental health needs. For more information, please visit our FAQs.

About Us

We're a global investment manager. We help institutions, intermediaries and individuals around the world invest money to meet their goals, fulfil their ambitions, and prepare for the future.

We have around 6,000 people on six continents. And we've been around for over 200 years, but keep adapting as society and technology changes. What doesn't change is our commitment to helping our clients, and society, prosper.

Description

Citi Research delivers industry-leading investment analysis to Citi’s global institutional investor and wealth management client base. Our team includes some 350 publishing analysts globally, with fundamental coverage of ~3,600 equity securities, as well as areas such as quantitative analysis, economics, fixed-income/rates/credit, FX, commodities, and data analytics. We also deliver access services such as conferences & events, corporate access & visits, and direct insights from market, policy, and industry experts.

Citi Research is seeking a Supervisory Analyst / Editor / Designated Quality Review Officer (DQRO) to join our nascent Shanghai-based Research office under Citigroup Securities (China) Co. Ltd. This is a role for a seasoned professional combining responsibilities in editorial, risk management, and operational processes. This role will primarily support and review research product produced by our new Shanghai team, both in English and Chinese. The role may also involve some review of global ex-PRC research product. The role requires strong editorial skills and financial/investment topics comprehension in order to filter, prioritize and validate potentially complex and dynamic material from multiple sources. Strong communication and diplomacy skills are required. Attention to detail is a must!

Key Responsibilities

  • Review investment research product to ensure compliance with PRC and US FINRA regulations, including reasonable basis and sourcing requirements.
  • Review investment research product to ensure compliance with Citi’s internal research content guidelines, as detailed in our research guidebooks and policies.
  • Edit investment research for quality, clarity, commerciality, style, and grammar.
  • Review both Chinese and English variants, including cross-checking consistency.
  • Review investment research language/tone and content for franchise risk, with consideration of the firm's reputation and business exposures, and in light of PRC and global political and client sensitivities. Be capable of editing to mitigate such risks (while maintaining our independent views), as well as determining when escalation is appropriate.
  • Handle the checking of investment research product for 1) issuer mentions for cross-checking against our Watch List; 2) the inclusion of appropriate disclaimers & disclosures; 3) data consistency; and 4) distribution tagging and other product & template elements.
  • Act as an editorial project manager, providing end-to-end traffic management of work-in-progress, liaising as needed with analyst teams, other Publications staff, product managers, control & compliance teams, data and technical support teams, and other relevant partners, to resolve problems and ensure product ultimately publishes. Additional managerial responsibilities may be assigned, given the need for flexibility in the small startup team.
  • Broadly as a Citi staffer, assess risk appropriately when business decisions are made, work in compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to policies, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.


Qualifications

Job Description

As a GLAM Relationship Specialist, you will help create a controlled and efficient experience for colleagues as they join, move within or leave the firm. You will build effective relationships with business stakeholders and partner teams to understand employee lifecycle needs and ensure timely resolution of requests. Working with Access Operations, Solutions teams and Technology partners, you will coordinate access to technology, applications, market data and buildings. The business will rely on you to help ensure each request is completed accurately, on time and in line with control standards. This role provides broad exposure to how the firm operates and an opportunity to improve the processes that support employee experience.

Job Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and track access needs for new hires, internal transfers, role changes and leavers.
  • Build effective relationships with business stakeholders and partner teams to understand employee lifecycle needs and keep requests moving.
  • Coordinate technology hardware, application, market data and building access requirements as needed.
  • Check requests against approved role requirements and confirm that the appropriate business and control approvals are in place.
  • Coordinate the prompt removal or amendment of access when employees leave or transfer.
  • Troubleshoot access and entitlement issues, working with Technology and support teams through to resolution.
  • Support regular access reviews and entitlement recertifications and coordinate the remediation of identified exceptions.
  • Maintain accurate and complete records of access requests, approvals and actions taken.
  • Partner with business managers and control functions to answer questions and support timely request completion.
  • Maintain a strong control and compliance environment and identify opportunities to reduce risk in daily processes.
  • Identify process gaps, escalate control concerns and contribute to improvements across access management and employee lifecycle processes.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills

  • Experience in operations, administrative support, technology support, or a similar role.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple requests, set priorities and follow tasks through completion.
  • Demonstrated accuracy and attention to detail when handling records, approvals or control processes.
  • Possess SAC license (or any other licenses / qualifications as required) for carrying out securities and other regulated activities.
  • Proficiency in written and spoken English.
  • Experience handling confidential information with discretion and professionalism
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with business and support partners.
  • Strong command of MS office suite of products

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills

  • Experience in access management, employee onboarding or offboarding, technology provisioning or operational support.
  • Experience working in financial services or another regulated industry.
  • Familiarity with access controls, entitlement reviews, issue tracking and audit support.
  • A track record of proactive problem-solving and process improvement.

About Us

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

Transaction Management will be responsible for supporting multiple aspects of the lending lifecycle including but not limited to loan closing and servicing coordination, facilitating complex client onboarding, data management, and quality control. The team will be accountable and responsible for operational oversight of the closing and servicing of all loan transactions of the business division being supported to ensure all internal and external requirements are met.

Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the build and development team to support loan origination and lifecycle management which includes large complex syndicated and bilateral loans covering but not limited to corporate, commercial, real estate, structured lending and trade.
  • Assist with the creation of processes, standards, procedures, controls, training, and implementation of transaction management.
  • Aid in the design and implementation of technology including testing and rollout.
  • Provide training and support to transaction management staff and business constituents.
  • Partner with each of the originating and coverage business lines, credit risk, operations, legal, etc.
  • Ensure that quality of data, controls and processes performed meet internal policies and regulatory requirements/expectations.
  • Work with lines of business, transaction management, and loan operations to define and implement operational metrics and risk and control reviews to ensure all stakeholders have end to end transparency.
  • Constantly improve processes, controls and efficiencies within the group and front to back across loan lifecycle
  • Participate in projects to enhance performance and efficiency.
  • Take part in loan remediation and loan system testing / migrations.
  • Actively manage and maintain a deal closing pipeline of loan transactions.
  • Coordinate and close loan transactions/lifecycle events, capture data, store documentation, troubleshoot issues/roadblocks, perform quality control
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.


Qualifications

  • 5-8 years of experience
  • Individual must have excellent communication, organizational and interpersonal skills.
  • Individual must work well under tight deadlines, manage priorities, and complete assigned tasks with minimal management follow up.
  • Candidate has quantitative skills with a high proficiency with Excel and other Microsoft based programs.
  • Tableau or visualization tool familiarity
  • Experience with Loan IQ, transaction capture tools, etc.
  • Keen attention to detail
  • Developed analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Client relationship and solution skills


Additional Non-core Qualifications Which Will Be Considered Are

  • Experience within a large global team supporting wholesale lending at large financial Institution
  • Knowledge of wholesale loan (syndicated / bilateral) product and business, including an understanding of legal loan documentation, loan / funding mechanics, deal structure, funds flows, etc.
  • Experience working with clients under time constraints to facilitate a transaction or process.
  • Proven ability to collaborate with team members, Senior management and other business constituents
  • Critical decision-making capabilities including the ability to identify, escalate, and propose solutions to problems
  • Ability to prioritize through the practice of strong organizational and time management skills with experience in continuously following-up with various stakeholders
  • Understanding and awareness of appropriate corporate and regulatory policies in relation to Lending
  • Deep understanding of operational processes supporting Wholesale lending
  • Focus on achieving/exceeding key operating standards within a KPI/metrics driven culture
  • Ability to work in an environment where priorities are frequently changing


Education

  • Bachelors/University degree or equivalent experience

Operations - Transaction Services

Who we are looking for

We are looking for an experienced fund accounting and alternative investment servicing professional to lead a group supporting complex client portfolios. This is a mid-level management role requiring strong technical judgement, operational discipline and the ability to coordinate across clients, counterparties and internal service teams. The successful candidate will take ownership of service delivery, controls, issue resolution and people development in a fast-paced environment with multiple deadlines and evolving operating models.

Why this role is important to us

The team you will be joining is part of Alternative Investment Solutions (AIS), a leading provider of fund accounting, fund administration and operational support services to alternative investment managers and institutional investors.

The team acts as a key coordination and control point across the alternative investment servicing lifecycle. The team connects client requirements with operational execution, helps ensure that investment, transaction, cash, valuation and reporting information is complete and accurate, and drives timely resolution of exceptions. The role is important in maintaining service quality, strengthening the control environment and supporting scalable, technology-enabled delivery across private equity, private credit, fund-of-funds and direct investment structures.

What you will be responsible for

  • Lead the day-to-day delivery of the team, set priorities, allocate resources and ensure activities are completed accurately and within agreed deadlines and service standards.
  • Act as a senior point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders. Maintain effective working relationships, manage expectations, communicate status clearly and escalate material risks or delays promptly.
  • Oversee client and investment onboarding activities, including review and coordination of investment attributes, legal and operational documentation, account and system setup, and hand-offs to downstream teams.
  • Provide oversight of cash and transaction-related activities, including capital calls, distributions, paydowns, interest and fee receipts, payment-in-kind events, transfers, adjustments and other investment lifecycle events, as applicable to the supported operating model.
  • Ensure cash reconciliation, cash reporting, transaction booking inputs and related supporting documentation are complete, accurate, timely and subject to appropriate maker-checker controls.
  • Oversee valuation and market value support processes, including collection and review of source documents, follow-up on missing information, reasonableness checks, exception investigation and coordination with valuation or accounting teams.
  • Coordinate document management activities and maintain evidence required to support operational processing, control execution, client reporting and audit requests.
  • Support annual audit and agreed-upon-procedure activities by coordinating document requests, population and sample evidence, issue follow-up and timely responses across process owners.
  • Own the review and resolution of service issues, exceptions, missed deadlines and potential operational incidents. Ensure root causes, impacts, remediation actions and preventive measures are appropriately documented and tracked to closure.
  • Monitor service performance through KPIs, issue logs, exception reporting and control evidence. Provide clear management reporting and identify trends requiring action.
  • Ensure procedures, checklists and controls remain current, consistently applied and aligned with the approved operating model. Promote strong information-security, confidentiality and risk-awareness practices.
  • Partner with technology, product, operations and project teams on new business, migrations, system enhancements and target operating model changes. Translate business scenarios into clear requirements and participate in testing, readiness and implementation activities.
  • Assess operational effectiveness and drive standardisation, automation and process improvements while maintaining appropriate controls and clear accountability across team hand-offs.
  • Lead, coach and develop team members and subordinate managers. Set objectives, provide timely feedback, support training and succession planning, and foster a collaborative, accountable and inclusive team culture.
  • Contribute to capacity planning, staffing proposals, budget inputs and broader business initiatives. Represent the function in governance forums, client discussions and cross-organisational working groups as required.


What we value

  • Strong ownership and accountability, with a client-service mindset and a consistent focus on quality and risk management.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of alternative investment operations and fund accounting, including private equity, private credit, fund-of-funds and direct investment structures.
  • Strong understanding of investment lifecycle events, including onboarding, funding, capital calls, distributions, repayments, valuations, restructurings and exits.
  • Ability to understand complex transaction and investment scenarios, identify control implications and make well-reasoned decisions based on available evidence.
  • Excellent organisation and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage multiple deliverables, changing priorities and time-sensitive escalations.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with close attention to detail and the ability to distinguish small but significant differences in documents, data and transaction terms.
  • Clear, confident written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical or operational matters to clients, senior management and cross-functional partners.
  • Ability to influence without relying solely on authority, build alignment across teams and drive actions through to completion.
  • People leadership capability, including coaching, delegation, performance management and development of technical and managerial talent.
  • Curiosity and a continuous-improvement mindset, with the confidence to challenge inefficient practices and propose practical, controlled solutions.
  • A professional, collaborative and resilient approach when working under pressure.


Education And Preferred Qualifications

  • University degree in accounting, finance, economics, business, mathematics or a related discipline. A professional accounting or investment qualification, or progress towards one, is an advantage.
  • At least 7 years of relevant experience in fund accounting, fund administration, alternative investment operations or a comparable financial-services environment, including 2 to 3 years of supervisory or management experience.
  • Experience supporting complex alternative investment products and multi-party operating models is strongly preferred.
  • Experience in client service, operational controls, issue management, audit support, process improvement, migrations or system implementation is preferred.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications. Experience with fund accounting, workflow, documentation or data-management platforms is an advantage.
  • Fluent written and spoken English. Ability to work effectively across locations, cultures and time zones.


Role scope and working relationships

The role works closely with client representatives, fund accounting and NAV teams, middle-office and transaction-processing teams, document management, reconciliation, valuation, financial reporting, audit, technology, product and project-management partners. Responsibilities may vary by client, investment type and target operating model; the Officer is expected to understand the applicable scope, maintain clear ownership and ensure that hand-offs are controlled.

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.
